content: Stripe and FedEx have formed a strategic connection focused on shipping data, utilizing these insights as a key indicator of business health. This collaboration aims to provide a clearer picture of market activity and economic trends by analyzing logistical patterns alongside financial transactions.

Mollie Recruits Founding Team for AI Financial Layer
summary:
Mollie today announced a new venture model to build a dedicated intelligence platform and banking layer for AI agents. The platform will give customers the ability to run their own AI agents directly against Mollie's payment and banking rails. Rather than staffing an internal product department, Mollie is actively recruiting a founding team, or considering early-stage startup acquihires, to build this platform from the ground up.
Mollie is committing an equity pool of up to €50 million in Mollie equity for the team. The equity is structured in tiers and is contingent on meeting predefined operational and commercial milestones.
The team will operate in a ring-fenced setup with full ownership over architecture, roadmap, and go-to-market. In addition to capital, the venture will leverage Mollie’s regulated banking rails, proprietary tech infrastructure, and distribution to over 350,000 businesses.
“As software shifts toward autonomous AI agents, dedicated financial infrastructure is required to support machine-driven transactions,” said Adriaan Mol founder Mollie. “Building this from zero requires high autonomy and the alignment of a founding team. This model bridges startup execution speed with the regulatory rails and scale Mollie has built over the past two decades.”
Team applications are open immediately through an accelerated diligence process.

Three in Ten Brits say High Street Banks Worsened, CRIF Data Shows
summary:
CRIF's 2026 survey of 5,000 European consumers finds traditional banks are the only financial provider type with a negative service-quality net score.
The post Three in Ten Brits say High Street Banks Worsened, CRIF Data Shows appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: A new survey by CRIF reveals that three in ten British consumers believe high street banks have worsened in service quality. The findings show traditional banks are the sole financial provider category to record a negative net score in customer satisfaction across Europe, highlighting growing consumer dissatisfaction with legacy banking institutions.
content_ta: CRIF நடத்திய புதிய ஆய்வில், பிரிட்டனில் உள்ள பத்து நுகர்வோர்களில் மூன்று பேர் உயர்வீதி வங்கிகளின் சேவை தரம் மோசமடைந்துள்ளதாகக் கூறியுள்ளனர். ஐரோப்பா முழுவதும் உள்ள பாரம்பரிய வங்கிகள் மட்டுமே வாடிக்கையாளர் திருப்தியில் எதிர்மறையான மதிப்பெண்ணைப் பெற்றுள்ள நிதி வழங்குநர்கள் என்பதை இந்த முடிவுகள் காட்டுகின்றன.
